rows.transcript_1:
Close your eyes.
Let's use the magic power of 3 to stay present and relax. 

Name 3 sounds you can hear right now.
Name 3 smells you can smell right now.
Name your 3 favourite foods.
What are 3 things you can be gratefful for right now.

At the end of a touch day, thinking of 3 things to be grateful for can help us find the courage to try again tomorrow.
rows.transcript_2:
Tutup mata anda.
Mari kita gunakan kuasa ajaib nombor 3 untuk kekal hadir dan bertenang.

Sebut 3 bunyi yang anda boleh dengar sekarang.
Sebut 3 bau yang anda boleh hidu sekarang.
Sebut 3 makanan kegemaran anda.
Apakah 3 perkara yang anda berasa bersyukur pada saat ini.

Di penghujung hari yang mencabar, fikirkan 3 perkara yang kita rasa bersyukur dan boleh membantu kita untuk mengumpul semula semangat untuk mencuba lagi pada esok hari.

Buka semula mata anda perlahan-lahan.

text_1_facilitator.eng: 3️⃣ Here are three simple ways you can start sharing family responsibilities with your spouse:

rows.text_1_facilitator: 3️⃣ Here are three simple ways you can start sharing family responsibilities with your spouse:

section_1_text.eng:
⏰ It can be easy to forget or feel overwhelmed by caregiving or housework tasks. Establishing a routine around these can help!
😃 It also gives you a chance to talk to your spouse about how to share the workload.

section_2_title.eng: TALK ABOUT THE WORKLOAD WITH YOUR SPOUSE

section_2_text.eng:
😃 Having conversations about how you can share family responsibilities helps both you and your spouse understand each other better. 
💛It also shows that you care!

section_3_text.eng:
😒 It can be hard to remember to ask for help. 
🌷 Be kind to yourself if you forget! You can try again another time. 
⭐ Asking for help and sharing responsibilities creates a more supportive home for everyone!
